TRUMP v. SLAUGHTER
Syllabus

Reversed and remanded.
Roberts, C. J., delivered the opinion of the Court, in which Alito,
Gorsuch, Kavanaugh, and Barrett, JJ., joined, and in which Thomas,
J., joined as to all but Part III–B. Gorsuch, J., fled a concurring opinion,
post, p. 464. Sotomayor, J., fled a dissenting opinion, in which Kagan
and Jackson, JJ., joined, post, p. 480.

Solicitor General Sauer argued the cause for petitioners.
With him on the briefs were Assistant Attorney General
Shumate, Deputy Solicitor General Harris, Deputy Assistant Attorney General McArthur, Vivek Suri, Mark R. Freeman, Michael S. Raab, Daniel Aguilar, Laura E. Myron,
and Alex Potapov.
Amit Agarwal argued the cause for respondents. With
